**Purpose:** Supplemental Figure 5.
Extracted and reorganized from `05_psites_analysis.Rmd`.

**S5 Fig:** Phosphoproteome expression modules (PEMs):
- **Panel A:** Computational overview / workflow diagram (Illustrator — not R).
- **Panel B:** PEM eigengene heatmap.
- **Panel C:** GO/KEGG enrichment per PEM.
- **Panel D:** Per-PEM phosphorylation dynamics.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/normed_pSite_ratio_perseus.csv`
- `tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv`

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("sfig/SFig_5.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)

out_dir  <- "sfig/plots"
data_dir <- "sfig/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
pSite <- read_csv("./tables/normed_pSite_ratio_perseus.csv",
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("id")) %>%
  drop_na(Proteins)
pSite[is.na(pSite)] <- 0

logFC_ttest_pS <- read_csv("./tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## S5B — PEM eigengene heatmap

Heatmap of phosphosite ratio profiles across all samples, clustered by row (pSite)
to reveal co-regulated phosphorylation modules (PEMs).

```{r s5b-heatmap}
# Build wide matrix: pSite × sample
pSite_tidy <- melt(pSite) %>%
  separate(variable, c("genotype", "nutrient", "samplingTime", "replicate"),
           sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% c("rim15KO", "WT"))

pSite_wide <- pSite_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  unite(col_key, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime, replicate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col_key, values_from = value,
              id_cols = pSite)

# Keep only pSites with q < 0.05 in at least one contrast
sig_psites <- logFC_ttest_pS %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>%
  pull(pSite) %>%
  unique()

hm_df <- pSite_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(pSite %in% sig_psites) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pSite")

# Remove columns/rows with excessive NAs
hm_df <- hm_df[, colSums(is.na(hm_df)) < nrow(hm_df) * 0.5]
hm_df <- hm_df[rowSums(is.na(hm_df)) < ncol(hm_df) * 0.5, ]

ann_col <- data.frame(
  genotype  = sub("_.*", "", colnames(hm_df)),
  nutrient  = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(hm_df)),
  time      = sub("^([^_]+_){2}([^_]+)_.*", "\\2", colnames(hm_df)),
  replicate = sub(".*_", "", colnames(hm_df)),
  row.names = colnames(hm_df))

ann_colors <- list(
  genotype  = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
  nutrient  = c("C" = "#ff9500", "P" = "#8300ab"),
  time      = c("T00" = "#fee8d0", "T06" = "#fdad60",
                "T16" = "#e85d04", "T30" = "#7f1900"),
  replicate = c("R1" = "#bae6c8", "R2" = "#44c76d", "R3" = "#016320"))

p_S5B <- pheatmap(
  hm_df,
  colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_cols    = FALSE,
  scale           = "row",
  annotation_col  = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  na_col          = "lightgrey",
  show_rownames   = FALSE,
  main            = paste0("Rim15-dependent phosphosites (n = ", nrow(hm_df),
                            ")\nnormalized SILAC ratio, row-scaled"),
  fontsize        = 8,
  fontsize_col    = 7,
  silent          = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "SFig5B_PEM_heatmap.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)
grid::grid.draw(p_S5B$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.draw(p_S5B$gtable)

write_csv(pSite_wide %>% dplyr::filter(pSite %in% sig_psites),
          file.path(data_dir, "SFig5B_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig5B: heatmap of ", nrow(hm_df), " significant phosphosites")
```

## S5C — GO enrichment per PEM cluster

```{r s5c-go, cache=TRUE}
# Assign PEM cluster membership from heatmap row clustering
if (nrow(hm_df) > 0) {
  hclust_row   <- hclust(dist(hm_df, method = "euclidean"), method = "complete")
  n_clusters   <- 4L  # adjust to match published figure
  cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
    pSite   = rownames(hm_df),
    cluster = cutree(hclust_row, k = n_clusters))

  # Join gene names for GO enrichment
  cluster_genes <- cluster_assignments %>%
    mutate(gene = sub("_\\d+$", "", pSite)) %>%
    group_by(cluster, gene) %>%
    summarise(n_sites = n(), .groups = "drop")

  enrich_list <- list()
  for (cl in unique(cluster_genes$cluster)) {
    genes_cl <- cluster_genes %>%
      dplyr::filter(cluster == cl) %>%
      pull(gene) %>%
      unique()

    ego <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
        gene          = genes_cl,
        universe      = sub("_\\d+$", "", sig_psites),
        ont           = "BP",
        keyType       = "GENENAME",
        OrgDb         = "org.Sc.sgd.db",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        qvalueCutoff  = 0.1),
      error = function(e) NULL)

    if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(ego@result) > 0)
      enrich_list[[cl]] <- ego@result %>% mutate(cluster = cl)
  }

  if (length(enrich_list) > 0) {
    enrich_df <- bind_rows(enrich_list)
    write_csv(enrich_df, file.path(data_dir, "SFig5C_source_data.csv"))

    p_S5C <- enrich_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.1, Count > 1) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = factor(cluster), y = Description,
                 color = p.adjust, size = Count)) +
      geom_point() +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "#FF3333", high = "#3399FF", name = "p.adjust") +
      xlab("PEM cluster") + ylab("GO Biological Process") +
      theme_cowplot(font_size = 9) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig5C_GO_enrichment.pdf"),
           p_S5C, width = 8, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
    p_S5C
  }
}
```

## S5D — Per-PEM phosphorylation dynamics

```{r s5d-dynamics}
if (exists("cluster_assignments") && nrow(cluster_assignments) > 0) {
  pSite_clust <- pSite_tidy %>%
    inner_join(cluster_assignments, by = "pSite") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), samplingTime %in% c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30"))

  pSite_clust_summary <- pSite_clust %>%
    group_by(cluster, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime) %>%
    summarise(mean_val = mean(log2(value + 1e-6), na.rm = TRUE),
              sem_val  = sd(log2(value + 1e-6), na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(samplingTime = factor(samplingTime,
                                  levels = c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30")),
           genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15KO")))

  p_S5D <- ggplot(pSite_clust_summary,
                  aes(x = samplingTime, y = mean_val,
                      group = genotype, color = genotype)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem_val,
                    ymax = mean_val + sem_val,
                    fill = genotype),
                alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_grid(cluster ~ nutrient,
               labeller = labeller(
                 nutrient = c("C" = "Carbon", "P" = "Phosphorus"))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                       labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                      labels  = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
    xlab("Hours post nutrient depletion") +
    ylab("Mean log2 phosphorylation (± SEM)") +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
          legend.title     = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank())

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig5D_PEM_dynamics.pdf"),
         p_S5D, width = 8, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
  p_S5D

  write_csv(pSite_clust_summary, file.path(data_dir, "SFig5D_source_data.csv"))
}
```
